  uid=8_158 StaticText "Sefamerve: The Signature of Quality and Trust in "
  uid=8_159 link "Modest Fashion" description="Modest Hijab Clothing Trends" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/islamic-clothing"
    uid=8_160 StaticText "Modest Fashion"
  uid=8_161 StaticText "Sefamerve is a style journey covering every moment of modern modest woman's life. Our collection, designed not just to cover but to help you feel good and express yourself correctly, offers solutions that touch every aspect of life. We blend traditional modesty with "Ecrin Knit Fabric" technology and seamless bonnet innovation to offer you not just clothes, but the very essence of comfort and serenity."
  uid=8_162 heading "Elegance and Protection in Outerwear" level="2"
  uid=8_163 StaticText "Our outerwear collection reflects your style moment you step outside, protecting your elegance regardless of season. With our "
  uid=8_164 link "Abaya" description="Abaya Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/abaya"
    uid=8_165 StaticText "Abaya"
  uid=8_166 StaticText " models harmonizing Ottoman aesthetics with modern lines, and our "
  uid=8_167 link "Coat" description="Coat Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/cape"
    uid=8_168 StaticText "Coat"
  uid=8_169 StaticText " (Kap) models that are lifesavers during seasonal transitions, you can display a noble stance. The "
  uid=8_170 link "Coats" description="Coat Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/coat"
    uid=8_171 StaticText "Coats"
  uid=8_172 StaticText " (Kaban) and "
  uid=8_173 link "Jackets" description="Jacket Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/winter-coat"
    uid=8_174 StaticText "Jackets"
  uid=8_175 StaticText " (Mont) options, which keep you warm in cold weather with quality fabrics, vary with stylish designs. Our "
  uid=8_176 link "Poncho" description="Poncho Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/poncho"
    uid=8_177 StaticText "Poncho"
  uid=8_178 StaticText " models, which are the soft expression of elegance, and our "
  uid=8_179 link "Jackets" description="Jacket Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/jacket"
    uid=8_180 StaticText "Jackets"
  uid=8_181 StaticText " (Ceket) collection add variety to your outerwear. For office elegance or special occasions, the sharp-featured "
  uid=8_182 link "Trenchcoat" description="Trenchcoat Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/trenchcoat"
    uid=8_183 StaticText "Trenchcoat"
  uid=8_184 StaticText " and classical "
  uid=8_185 link "Pardesu" description="Pardesu Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/outer-wear/topcoat"
    uid=8_186 StaticText "Pardesu"
  uid=8_187 StaticText " selections highlight your style to the outside world."
  uid=8_188 heading "Daily Chic and the Art of Combining" level="2"
  uid=8_189 StaticText "For those seeking comfort and style together throughout the day, our dresses produced with "Ecrin Knit Fabric" technology—non-ironing and non-see-through—and our "
  uid=8_190 link "Suits" description="Modest Suits" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/islamic-clothing/suit"
    uid=8_191 StaticText "Suits"
  uid=8_192 StaticText " (Takım) options that eliminate the hassle of combining are ideal. For a dynamic style, you can choose our long "
  uid=8_193 link "Tunics" description="Tunic Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/islamic-clothing/tunic"
    uid=8_194 StaticText "Tunics"
  uid=8_195 StaticText ", chic "
  uid=8_196 link "Blouses" description="Blouse Models" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/islamic-clothing/shirt"
    uid=8_197 StaticText "Blouses"
  uid=8_198 StaticText " (Gömlek) and sporty "

  uid=8_217 heading "Special Occasions and Spiritual World" level="2"
  uid=8_218 StaticText "To be the most stylish and confident guest at your special events, celebrations, and invitations, our "

  uid=8_228 heading "Active Lifestyle Freedom" level="2"

  uid=8_247 heading "Frequently Asked Questions" level="3"
  uid=8_248 LineBreak "
"
  uid=8_249 heading "What distinguishes Sefamerve from other modest fashion sites?" level="4"
  uid=8_250 StaticText "Sefamerve is not just a sales site but the pioneer of innovation in modest fashion. We make a difference with Seamless Bonnet technology"
  uid=8_251 heading "Do your tracksuits reveal body lines?" level="4"
  uid=8_252 StaticText "No. In Sefamerve "
  uid=8_253 link "Modest Tracksuits" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/islamic-clothing/islamic-sportswear"
    uid=8_254 StaticText "Modest Tracksuits"
  uid=8_255 heading "Do your fabrics show through?" level="4"
  uid=8_256 StaticText "Absolutely no. Our own technology"
  uid=8_257 heading "Are your plus size options wide?" level="4"
  uid=8_258 StaticText "Yes. "
  uid=8_259 link "Plus Size" url="https://www.sefamerve.com/en/k/plus-size"
    uid=8_260 StaticText "Plus Size"
  uid=8_261 StaticText " is our main philosophy. Wide size options (range 44-60) are available in our entire collection from tunics to abayas"
  uid=8_262 heading "Is Sefamerve reliable?" level="4"
  uid=8_263 StaticText "Yes, Sefamerve has been one of Turkey's most established modest fashion e-commerce sites since 2010. It offers secure shopping with a high resolution rate on Şikayetvar, SSL security certificate, 3D Secure payment infrastructure, and legal return guarantee. Serving millions of customers, Sefamerve is a licensed e-commerce platform registered with the Ministry of Trade."
  uid=8_264 heading "How are Sefamerve user reviews? Is the price-performance ratio good?" level="4"
  uid=8_265 StaticText "Highlights in Sefamerve user reviews include: affordable price policy, wide product range, fast shipping, and easy return process. In terms of price-performance, offering quality products at prices below the market average increases customer satisfaction. Its mobile app, rated 4+ on Google Play and App Store, also facilitates the user experience."
  uid=8_266 heading "Is Sefamerve or Modanisa better quality?" level="4"
  uid=8_267 StaticText "Both sites are Turkey's leading modest fashion platforms. While Sefamerve stands out with its domestic production-weighted collections and competitive prices, Modanisa offers international brand diversity. Sefamerve's strengths are: more affordable prices, fast domestic shipping, extensive plus-size options, and local designer brands."
  uid=8_268 heading "What is the target age group for Sefamerve?" level="4"
  uid=8_269 StaticText "Sefamerve appeals to a wide audience between the ages of 18-65. It offers options suitable for all age groups with young collections (16-25 years), office and daily wear (25-45 years), stylish evening wear and special occasion outfits (all age groups), and elegant dresses for mothers/mothers-in-law over 60."
  uid=8_270 heading "How much are Sefamerve modest evening dress prices? Are there evening dresses under 1500 TL?" level="4"
  uid=8_271 StaticText "Yes, modest evening dress models starting from 500 TL are available at Sefamerve. You can use the price filter in the 'Evening Wear' category for stylish options under 1500 TL. You can find more affordable evening dresses with discounts up to 50% during end-of-season sales and special campaign periods."
  uid=8_272 heading "How is the Sefamerve vs Modanisa price comparison?" level="4"
  uid=8_273 StaticText "Sefamerve generally offers prices 10-20% more affordable than Modanisa. The price advantage is especially evident in domestic brands and plus-size products. Sefamerve's free shipping limit and frequently organized campaigns also reduce the total shopping cost."
  uid=8_274 heading "Sefamerve current campaigns and discounts 2026" level="4"
  uid=8_275 StaticText "Various campaigns are organized throughout the year at Sefamerve: End-of-season discounts (30-70%), Ramadan and Eid campaigns, Black Friday discounts, new member discounts, and mobile app-exclusive deals. Check the 'Discount' section on the website and mobile app notifications to follow current campaigns."
  uid=8_276 heading "How much is the Sefamerve shipping fee in 2026?" level="4"
  uid=8_277 StaticText "Free shipping is offered for orders over a certain amount at Sefamerve. The standard shipping fee varies according to the order amount and delivery region. Check the 'Shipping and Delivery' page on the website for the current shipping fee and free shipping limit."
  uid=8_278 heading "How many days is the Sefamerve return policy? Is there free return?" level="4"
  uid=8_279 StaticText "Product returns can be made within the scope of the 14-day right of withdrawal at Sefamerve. Return conditions: the product must be unused, tags must not be removed, and it must be in its original packaging. The return shipping fee policy may vary depending on the order amount."
  uid=8_280 heading "Is Sefamerve's shipping policy faster than other sites?" level="4"
  uid=8_281 StaticText "Sefamerve offers a delivery time of 1-3 business days throughout Turkey. Next-day delivery is usually possible in metropolitan cities. Working with contracted cargo companies, Sefamerve sends SMS and e-mail notifications for order tracking."
